title: Advisory verifier report preview v1
description: Transport shape only. Runtime validation is mandatory for duplicate keys, byte budget, semantics, expected bindings and EOA signature recovery. Not a protocol-v0 AdvisoryRecord.

artifactURI.description: Runtime enforces 2048 UTF-8 bytes, no credentials, fragment, whitespace, controls or backslash. Never fetched.

signature.description: Runtime requires valid r, canonical low-s and EOA typed-data recovery matching the selected verifier.

uint256.description: Runtime also enforces uint256 maximum; chainId must be positive.

address.description: Runtime rejects zero addresses and requires verifier distinct from client and producer.

hash.description: Runtime rejects zero digests. requestHash and criteriaHash are keccak256; artifactSha256 is SHA-256.
